# VolStrata MCP tool reference

Every tool the VolStrata MCP server projects, derived from the public capability catalog and from an un-credentialed `tools/list` call.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Endpoint | `POST https://volstrata.com/api/v1/mcp` |
| Protocol | `JSON-RPC 2.0` |
| API version | `2026-09-09` |
| Catalog fingerprint | `sha256:effea7406006c1cf2af82b839dfafb1934a227cc0e4ddad4b88d5134b04d95c2` |
| Generated by | `python scripts/sync_catalog.py` |

**3 meta-tools + 174 capability tools = 177 tools** for a fully entitled caller. **67** are reachable anonymously - a caller sending no credentials sees exactly those in `tools/list`, and `tools/call` refuses the rest with JSON-RPC error `-32001` naming the plan required.

A capability tool's name is identical to its REST `operationId`, and `Path` is the REST route the tool calls on your behalf. Meta-tools are served by the MCP endpoint itself and have no REST route of their own.

## Meta-tools

| Tool | Method | Path | Plan | Anonymous |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `capability.call` | - | - | Free | Yes |
| `catalog.search` | - | - | Free | Yes |
| `docs.search` | - | - | Free | Yes |

- `capability.call` - Call any capability
- `catalog.search` - Search the capability catalog
- `docs.search` - Search the metric glossary
